note: The TeX keeps the printed reading (checked on a crop: '=' and 'W∩F'). F is the trace on W of the closed set V(a) of U, so F=W∩V(a); since F⊂W, the printed V(a)=W∩F would say V(a)=F, which fails when V(a) has points outside W. Mathematical slip, not typographical; the exact intended wording is a guess.
